communityLeadReview.policy: Community and Reddit posts may identify leads. A mapped residence needs an unambiguous, publicly advertised site address and current program corroboration. Mailing/contact addresses, private or confidential homes, and old program associations are not enough.
communityLeadReview.redditOutcome: Program-name searches on Reddit did not yield an address that could be corroborated. No Reddit claims or inferred residence coordinates enter the directory.
